chapter1.title: FROM MOTION TO VERDICT
chapter1.desc: Turn a question into a battle of ideas. Engage in structured real-time debates judged by artificial intelligence.

chapter2.title: Every motion has more than one truth
chapter2.desc: Align with your perspective. Formulate core arguments and prepare to substantiate your stance under opposition scrutiny.
chapter2.propDesc: Affirmative case files. Defend the motion using logical deductions, structured frameworks, and empirical warrants.
chapter2.oppDesc: Negative refutations. Challenge assumptions, expose logical inconsistencies, and construct a compelling counter-case.

chapter3.title: Build your reasoning. Challenge assumptions.
chapter3.desc: Connect logic nodes to formulate a compelling, coherent debate framework that withstands interrogation.

chapter4.title: Speak live. Respond under pressure.
chapter4.desc: Step onto the digital podium. Express reasoning clearly, adapt to cross-examinations, and manage your clock in real time.

chapter5.title: Judged by reasoning, not volume
chapter5.desc: Our AI analysis engine processes speech recordings, detects fallacies, dissects arguments, and scores based on substance.
chapter5.fallacyDesc: Identifies circular reasoning, ad hominem attacks, strawman fallacies, and structural invalidity automatically.
chapter5.speechDesc: Evaluates key claims, responses, cross-examination value, and communication clarity to provide objective verdicts.

chapter6.title: Your argument changes here.
chapter6.desc: Enter the matchmaking queue, host private debate rounds with customized structures, and receive actionable insights to hone your speech.
